task_spec: Implement an LRUCache(capacity) with get(key) and put(key, value). It evicts the least-recently-USED entry when full. IMPORTANT: both a get AND a put (including overwriting an existing key's value) count as a use and make that key the most recently used.

bugs.description: put() on an EXISTING key overwrites the value and returns early WITHOUT refreshing recency (it never touches self._order). Per the spec a write is a use, so the updated key should become most-recently-used; instead it keeps its old position and can be wrongly evicted as stale despite being just written. Correct: move the key to the end of _order on update.

provenance.note: bespoke stateful interaction bug; no textbook pattern, no worked example
